originality.rationale: The accepted claim is the entire Q4 maximal-independent-set Boolean trace complex including nonpure antipodal-pair facets and 104 quartet facets in three affine-isometry orbits. This is not the known count of 42 maximal independent sets, nor a general upper bound, nor a graph-family renaming. Actual indexed and primary comparisons found no decisive statement implying the full finite classification. The close Ignatov chapter is accessible only by abstract and auxiliary repository description and remains an explicit material priority risk.
residual_risks: The 2023 Ignatov full chapter, which studies MIS sets of Q4 and formal concept lattices, was not accessible for complete table/appendix inspection; unindexed equivalent facet information is possible.
Indexed published-finding corpus abstracts are not a guarantee of full-document absence; no claim of global uniqueness or independent historical certification.
The 2024 manuscript discusses the same MIS incidence system abstractly and proves a dual VC bound, so the new claim is restricted to the complete Q4 face-orbit classification.
Small finite computations could have appeared in unpublished code or mathematical tables unknown to the accessible searches.

value.rationale: The unwhiskered four-cube is a canonical small, highly symmetric, vertex-transitive Hamming graph. The complete structure—not the known MIS count—shows the first nonpure shattered-support complex in the natural cubical sequence, identifies eight sharp antipodal obstructions and three distinct quartet symmetry orbits, and proves a concrete failure of matroidality. These refined support invariants are not determined by scalar VC bounds or MIS size polynomials and directly motivate the exact finite classification.
